fullPassage: Within the garment design field, prioritizing the environmental impact of a product is commonly known as eco-fashion. Eco-fashion argues for a more environmentally sustainable production and consumption of garments. Negative environmental impacts can occur at every point along the life of a product, from production to consumption to disposal. While these negative impacts are present in many aspects of the textile industry, they are particularly prevalent within the fashion industry. There is a seemingly inherent contradiction between fashion and environmental sustainability. The fashion industry is concerned with novelty and must be constantly in flux. The industry can be characterized by the fast rate at which something becomes outdated. In contrast, sustainability is primarily understood as the capacity to continue for an extended period of time. Whether the sustainability in question refers to the consumption of natural resources, relevance of a particular style, or durability of a particular garment, the current state of the fashion industry is not sustainable.

The industry can be characterized by the fast rate at which something becomes (C)[outdated / fashionable]. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 에코패션은 더 환경적으로 '지속 가능한' 생산·소비를 주장한다. 부정적 영향은 패션 산업에 특히 '만연해' 있다. 패션 산업은 무언가가 '구식이 되는' 빠른 속도로 특징지어진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① sustainable — prevalent — outdated: 원문 일치
❌ ② wasteful(낭비적인)은 원문 sustainable(지속 가능한)의 반의어
❌ ③ rare(드문)은 원문 prevalent(만연한)의 반의어
❌ ④ fashionable(유행하는)은 원문 outdated(구식의)의 반의어

det.korean: (A)의 flux는 '끊임없는 변화(constant change)', (B)의 flux는 금속을 녹이고 접합할 때 쓰는 '용융제(soldering material)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 변화 — (B) 용융제: (A)는 trends change라는 문맥에서 '변화', (B)는 metal worker·molten metal·soldering에서 '용융제'
❌ ② (A) 용융제 — (B) 변화: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)가 '흐름'이 아니라 '용융제(금속 접합용)'
❌ ④ (A)가 '용융제'가 아니라 '변화'
det.tip: flux: 일반 문맥 '변화', 금속/야금 문맥 '용융제'. 주변 단어로 의미 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to continue or last for a long period of time without harming the environment"

det.korean: sustainability = 지속가능성 (환경을 해치지 않고 오랜 기간 지속되거나 유지되는 능력)
det.analysis:
❌ ① novelty(새로움): 새로움이지 '지속되는 능력'이 아님
❌ ② consumption(소비): 소비이지 '지속 능력'이 아님
❌ ③ contradiction(모순): 모순이지 '지속 능력'이 아님
✅ ④ sustainability(지속가능성): 환경 훼손 없이 장기간 지속되는 능력이라는 정의에 정확히 부합

questions.passage: Within the garment design field, prioritizing the environmental impact of a product is commonly known as eco-fashion. Eco-fashion __________ (argue) for a more environmentally sustainable production and consumption of garments.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

argue → ____

det.korean: 에코패션은 더 환경적으로 지속 가능한 의류의 생산과 소비를 '주장한다'.
det.analysis: 주어 Eco-fashion은 3인칭 단수. 현재시제 동사는 -s 어미 필요. argue → argues로 변환. Eco-fashion argues for... (에코패션은 ~을 주장한다).
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 + 현재시제 동사 → 동사에 -s 어미. argue → argues

questions.passage: The fashion industry is concerned with novelty and must be constantly in flux. The industry can be __________ (characterize) by the fast rate at which something becomes outdated.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

characterize → ____

det.korean: 그 산업은 무언가가 구식이 되는 빠른 속도로 '특징지어질' 수 있다.
det.analysis: can be + p.p. = 수동태 조동사 구조. 주어(The industry)가 '특징지어지는' 대상이므로 과거분사 characterized(수동)로 변환. can be characterized by = ~로 특징지어질 수 있다.
det.tip: can be + p.p. = 수동태. characterize → characterized (수동 과거분사)

questions.passage: Within the garment design field, prioritizing the environmental impact of a product is commonly known as eco-fashion. Eco-fashion argues for a more environmentally sustainable production and consumption of garments. Negative environmental impacts can occur at every point along the life of a product, from production to consumption to disposal. While these negative impacts are present in many aspects of the textile industry, they are particularly prevalent within the fashion industry. There is a seemingly inherent contradiction between fashion and environmental sustainability. The fashion industry is concerned with novelty and must be constantly __________. The industry can be characterized by the fast rate at which something becomes outdated. In contrast, sustainability is primarily understood as the capacity to continue for an extended period of time. Whether the sustainability in question refers to the consumption of natural resources, relevance of a particular style, or durability of a particular garment, the current state of the fashion industry is not sustainable.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 끊임없이 변화하는(in flux). 패션 산업이 '새로움'에 관심을 두고 끊임없이 변화해야 한다는 문맥의 결론구.
det.analysis:
❌ ① in contrast(대조적으로): 뒷문장 연결부사로 쓰이는 표현이지 상태를 나타내지 않음
❌ ② in question(문제의, 해당): '지속가능성' 뒤에 붙는 후치수식구로 '끊임없이 변화하는'이라는 동적 상태 의미 없음
✅ ③ in flux(끊임없이 변하는): 패션 산업이 '새로움'에 관심을 두는 만큼 끊임없이 변화해야 한다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ in disposal(폐기 중): 제품 수명의 폐기 단계 명사와만 쓰이는 말로 산업 전체 상태 표현 불가
det.tip: in flux = 끊임없이 변화하는 상태에 있는

questions.passage: Within the garment design field, prioritizing the environmental impact of a product is commonly known as eco-fashion. Eco-fashion argues for a more environmentally sustainable production and consumption of garments. Negative environmental impacts can occur at every point along the life of a product, from production to consumption to disposal. While these negative impacts are present in many aspects of the textile industry, they are particularly prevalent within the fashion industry. There is a seemingly inherent contradiction between fashion and environmental sustainability. The fashion industry is concerned with novelty and must be constantly in flux. The industry can be characterized by the fast rate at which something becomes outdated. In contrast, sustainability is primarily understood as the capacity to continue for __________. Whether the sustainability in question refers to the consumption of natural resources, relevance of a particular style, or durability of a particular garment, the current state of the fashion industry is not sustainable.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 장기간(an extended period of time). 지속가능성이 '장기간' 계속될 수 있는 능력이라는 정의.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a particular style(특정한 스타일): 뒤 Whether절의 예시로 쓰이는 표현이지 지속가능성의 '시간적 정의'가 아님
✅ ② an extended period of time(장기간): '지속가능성'의 정의 — 오랜 시간 지속되는 능력
❌ ③ a particular garment(특정한 의복): Whether절의 또 다른 예시 표현이지 시간 정의가 아님
❌ ④ natural resources(천연자원): Whether절의 예시이지 빈칸이 속한 '지속가능성의 정의' 자리에는 시간 표현이 필요
det.tip: sustainability = the capacity to continue for an extended period of time
